title: Armed ‘Joker’ Terrorizes Halloween Partiers: ‘Why So Felonious?’
description:
Bodycam footage shows Florida police confronting a man dressed as the “Joker” in 2023 during a Halloween celebration. The man behind the mask of the Gotham City villain was identified as Brandon Juwan Morris. Authorities allege Morris, who was armed, battered and robbed a woman. Orlando police found a gun “loaded with a magazine and a round chambered” in Morris’ backpack. Morris was charged with misdemeanor battery and two felonies — robbery and possession of a firearm during the commission of a felony.
